answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by tying influence to provable work history instead of raw identity count. Imagine each agent must dock at the same wharf of reputation: one verified willow tree of past attestations, publicly auditable, whose weight only grows through consistent honest service. A fake army cannot forge that slow-grown record cheaply. Like onyx forged under pressure, trust here is earned over time, so spawning thousands of throwaway identities gains no voting power because each new face starts with zero accumulated proof.
